en_title: Senior Advocate Passes Away Due to Sudden Cardiac Arrest in Guna, Madhya Pradesh
hi_title: मध्य प्रदेश के गुना में अचानक कार्डियक अरेस्ट से वरिष्ठ अधिवक्ता का निधन
en_body:
## Incident Summary

A prominent senior advocate in Guna, Madhya Pradesh, Lokendra Shrimal, passed away following a sudden cardiac arrest. The incident, which was captured on surveillance footage, occurred when the advocate was reportedly parking his scooter outside his residence.

## Details of the Incident

According to reports published by Live Hindustan, the incident transpired as follows:

*   **Event Sequence:** Mr. Shrimal was in the process of parking his vehicle when he suddenly lost consciousness and collapsed.
*   **Cause:** The death has been attributed to a sudden cardiac arrest.
*   **Response:** The collapse happened rapidly, leaving little time for bystanders or family members to provide immediate assistance.

## Community Impact and Eye Donation

Following the news of his passing, the legal community at the Guna District Court expressed deep shock and grief. Mr. Shrimal was well-regarded in the local area, and his sudden demise has left his colleagues and acquaintances in mourning.

In a gesture described as an exemplary act of humanity, the family of the deceased honored a prior pledge made by Mr. Shrimal to donate his eyes. By fulfilling this commitment, his family has provided an opportunity for two visually impaired individuals to regain their sight. This act has been noted for its message of social contribution even after death.

## Verification

Details regarding this incident are based on local reporting. For further information or official statements regarding the circumstances of the event, interested parties may refer to reports issued by local law enforcement or regional news outlets in Madhya Pradesh.
hi_body:
मध्य प्रदेश के गुना शहर में स्कूटर पार्क करते समय अचानक तबीयत बिगड़ने से एक वरिष्ठ अधिवक्ता लोकेंद्र श्रीमाल का निधन हो गया। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, यह घटना उनके घर के बाहर हुई और इसका सीसीटीवी फुटेज सामने आया है।

## घटना और स्थानीय प्रतिक्रिया
* **घटना स्थल:** गुना, मध्य प्रदेश, भारत।
* **कारण:** कथित तौर पर कार्डियक अरेस्ट।
* **प्रभाव:** इस आकस्मिक निधन से जिला न्यायालय परिसर और स्थानीय अधिवक्ता समुदाय में शोक की लहर है।

## नेत्रदान का निर्णय
इस दुखद समय में परिवार ने लोकेंद्र श्रीमाल के नेत्रदान का संकल्प पूरा कराया, जिससे दो दृष्टिहीन लोगों को मदद मिलने की उम्मीद है। 

इस तरह की स्थानीय घटनाओं की पुष्टि के लिए आधिकारिक बयानों और संबंधित स्थानीय निकायों की जानकारी ली जा सकती है।
